questions.question:
Which of the mathematical signs should be interchanged in the below equation to make it mathematically correct?

135 ÷ 15 × 27 + 3 - 18 = 252
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e90e09179bf104951517e54e9e84fe472d5c3a697cd44fd6fa22d2707214f052.png] 

Given:

⇒ 135 ÷ 15 × 27 + 3 - 18 = 252

(1) **+ and ×**

⇒ 135 ÷ 15 × 27 + 3 - 18 = 252

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ __**135 ÷ 15**__ + 27 × 3 - 18

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 9 + __**27 × 3**__ - 18

⇒ 9 + 81 - 18

⇒ 90 - 18 = 72

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) **÷ and ×**

⇒ 135 ÷ 15 × 27 + 3 - 18 = 252

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 135 × __**15 ÷ 27**__ + 3 - 18

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**135 × 0.55**__ + 3 - 18

⇒ 75 + 3 - 18

⇒ 78 - 18 = 60

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(3) **÷ and +**

⇒ 135 ÷ 15 × 27 + 3 - 18 = 252

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 135 + 15 × __**27 ÷ 3**__ - 18

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 135 + __**15 × 9**__ - 18

⇒ 135 + 135 - 18

⇒ 270 - 18 = **252**

**⇒ '135 + 15 × 27 ÷ 3 - 18 = 252'**

Here, the equation is satisfied.

(4) **+ and -**

⇒ 135 ÷ 15 × 27 + 3 - 18 = 252

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ __**135 ÷ 15**__ × 27 - 3 + 18

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**9 × 27**__ - 3 + 18

⇒ 243 - 3 + 18

⇒ 261 - 3 = 258

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All apples are cake.

All cakes are bananas.

Some bananas are fruit.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some apples are cake.

II. Some bananas are apples.

III. Some fruits are bananas.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions II and III follow.
Both conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
Statements:

All apples are cake.

All cakes are bananas.

Some bananas are fruit.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/832d906e339aa43e2851d15137316fc36f2a8b043a54e4a910e88afe04f84599.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some apples are cake. → **True** (Because all apples are cake, which means some apples are cake is definitely true)

II. Some bananas are apples. →** True** (Because all apples are cake and all cakes are bananas, which means some bananas are apples is definitely true)

III. Some fruits are bananas. → **True** (Because some bananas are fruit, which means some fruits are bananas is definitely true)

So, All conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/466660ab0f24375806fc8f2dc0269e63944654578db0f423fac50d50cc6abe0a.png]

​⇒ 24 B 12 A 8 C 10 D 6

After putting the sign:

​⇒ 24 × __**12 ÷ 8**__ + 10 - 6

Apply BODMAS rule:

​⇒ __**24 × 1.5**__ + 10 - 6

​⇒ 36 + 10 - 6

​⇒ 46 - 6 = **40**

​⇒ '24 × 12 ÷ 8 + 10 - 6 = 40'

Here, the value of the equation is **'40'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
